name: search_feedback
description: Literal keyword search in a completed current feedback result or the snapshot of an authorized historical feedback report. Returns matching original previews and reply context; matched_records is NOT a full-topic count. No LLM analysis or publication.

result_id.description: Current-run evidence_id from analyze_feedback or read_report, never an arbitrary analysis or artifact ID.

query.description: Literal keyword matched case-insensitively in original text or reply context, not a semantic question.

offset.description: Zero-based offset among keyword matches; continue using next_offset.

limit.description: Maximum matching records per page, from 1 to 10; default 10.
